full_prompt_en: This is a square, grim fantasy illustration of a lone armored warrior standing before a large flat crimson disk on a rough red field. The figure occupies the lower center, shown almost full length in side view with the head bowed slightly toward the left. A pointed hood and layered dark metal armor conceal most of the face and body. Shoulder plates, ribbed arm guards, straps, hanging cloth, and battered lower panels build a complex silhouette. One long sword angles diagonally toward the lower left, while a shorter dark blade points down along the right side. Torn black fabric trails from the rear of the figure and breaks into ragged shapes near the left edge. The round bright red disk sits directly behind the upper body, sharply separated from the deeper scarlet and black-red surrounding ground. The lower area is dusty rust and brown, with loose particulate texture around the boots rather than a detailed landscape. A restrained light from the left catches worn edges of armor, the hood ridge, and a few hanging details; most surfaces remain in charcoal shadow. Scratches and rough brush marks keep the metal and background tactile, while the disk is comparatively smooth and graphic. The figure's small scale against the red circle and broad empty upper field gives the scene a heraldic stillness despite the implied weapons. No text or architecture is visible. The overall composition is severe and iconic, balancing a dense dark vertical shape against a saturated, almost abstract red backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的暗黑奇幻插画，一名孤身铠甲武士立在粗糙红色画域中的巨大平面绯红圆盘前。人物占据下方中央，几乎全身侧向入画，头略朝左低下。尖顶兜帽和层叠深色金属盔甲遮住大部分面孔与身体。肩甲、带纹护臂、绑带、垂布和破损的下方甲片构成复杂剪影。一把长剑斜向左下，另一把较短的深色刀刃沿右侧向下。撕裂的黑布从人物后方拖出，在左边缘附近碎成参差形状。明亮的大红圆盘正好位于上身后方，与四周更深的绯红和黑红底面清楚分开。下方区域呈尘土般的锈色和褐色，靴周围有松散颗粒肌理，而非详尽风景。克制的左侧光照到磨损甲片边、兜帽脊线和少量垂饰，大部分表面仍在炭色阴影中。刮痕和粗笔触让金属与背景都有触感，圆盘则相对平顺而图形化。人物相对于红圆和上方大片空域显得渺小，使画面虽有武器暗示，仍保持徽章般的静止。没有文字或建筑。整体构图严厉而具标志性，以密集深色竖形平衡饱和、近乎抽象的红色背景。
style_prompt_en: The graphic fantasy treatment opposes a saturated red field to a small, intricately worked charcoal mass. A simple smooth circle provides a calm focal plane behind jagged, layered contours. Dark metallic surfaces carry scratches, narrow highlights, and rough matte patches; the surrounding color field holds smoky variation rather than realistic scenery. A diagonal stroke interrupts the dominant vertical silhouette, adding controlled tension. Light is sparse and directional, catching exposed edges while deep recesses remain black. Broad negative space gives the central form scale and symbolic weight. The overall effect is severe, ritualistic, and tactile, with complexity concentrated in one area against a blunt color geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 这种图形化奇幻处理让饱和红色画域与一小块精细刻画的炭黑体量相对。简单平顺的圆形在参差、层叠的轮廓后方提供安静焦点平面。深色金属表面有刮痕、细窄高光与粗哑斑块；周围色域带烟雾般变化，而非写实风景。一道斜线打断主导的竖向剪影，加入受控张力。光稀少且有方向，只照到外露边缘，深凹处仍为黑色。宽阔负空间给予中央形体尺度与象征重量。整体效果严厉、带仪式感且有触感，复杂性集中在一处，与直接的色彩几何相对。
theme_en: A lone armored warrior with swords before a flat crimson disk
theme_zh: 一名持剑铠甲武士立于平面绯红圆盘前
name: Grimdark
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
